shortcodes.name: info
shortcodes.title: Information
shortcodes.meaning: A notice that gives the reader information, set apart from the text around it.

arguments.name: title
arguments.description: The notice's title, in inline Markdown. It is the whole argument.

shortcodes.name: note
shortcodes.title: Note
shortcodes.meaning: A notice of something the reader should take note of, set apart from the text around it.

arguments.name: title
arguments.description: The notice's title, in inline Markdown. It is the whole argument.

shortcodes.name: tip
shortcodes.title: Tip
shortcodes.meaning: A notice that gives the reader a helpful tip, set apart from the text around it.

arguments.name: title
arguments.description: The notice's title, in inline Markdown. It is the whole argument.

shortcodes.name: warning
shortcodes.title: Warning
shortcodes.meaning: A notice that warns the reader of a risk, set apart from the text around it.

arguments.name: title
arguments.description: The notice's title, in inline Markdown. It is the whole argument.

shortcodes.name: expand
shortcodes.title: Expand
shortcodes.meaning: A section the reader opens and closes, with its title showing while it is closed.

arguments.name: title
arguments.description: The title shown while the section is closed, in inline Markdown. It is the whole argument, and More when absent.

shortcodes.name: status
shortcodes.title: Status
shortcodes.meaning: A short status label with a colour that says how things stand.

arguments.name: colour
arguments.description: One of grey, blue, green, yellow or red. gray and amber are also read.

arguments.name: label
arguments.description: The words of the label.

shortcodes.name: toc
shortcodes.title: Contents
shortcodes.meaning: A linked list of the document's headings.

arguments.name: min
arguments.description: The first heading level listed, from 1 to 6.

arguments.name: max
arguments.description: The last heading level listed, from 1 to 6.

shortcodes.name: anchor
shortcodes.title: Anchor
shortcodes.meaning: A named place in the document that a link can go to.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: The anchor's name, a letter and then letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.

shortcodes.name: page
shortcodes.title: Page Link
shortcodes.meaning: A link to another page of the same site, by the page's address on it.

arguments.name: slug
arguments.description: The page's address on the site.

arguments.name: text
arguments.description: The words of the link. The slug is shown when absent.

shortcodes.name: figure
shortcodes.title: Figure
shortcodes.meaning: A picture from a file or an address, with an optional caption.

arguments.name: src
arguments.description: The picture's path or address.

arguments.name: alt
arguments.description: A description for someone who cannot see it.

arguments.name: width
arguments.description: The largest width it is drawn at.

arguments.name: caption
arguments.description: The caption, in inline Markdown.

shortcodes.name: diagram
shortcodes.title: Diagram
shortcodes.meaning: A diagram drawn from a saved D2, Mermaid or Canvas file, with an optional caption. The file stays the diagram's source.

arguments.name: src
arguments.description: The diagram file's path, ending in .d2, .mmd, .mermaid or .canvas.

arguments.name: alt
arguments.description: A description for someone who cannot see it.

arguments.name: width
arguments.description: The largest width it is drawn at.

arguments.name: caption
arguments.description: The caption, in inline Markdown.

shortcodes.name: applet
shortcodes.title: Applet
shortcodes.meaning: An application of the hosting site running inside the page.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: The application's name.

arguments.name: fit
arguments.description: flow or fill.

arguments.name: state
arguments.description: The state the application starts in.

shortcodes.name: video
shortcodes.title: Video
shortcodes.meaning: A video played in the page from YouTube or Vimeo.

arguments.name: src
arguments.description: The video's link, or the service's name (youtube or vimeo).

arguments.name: id
arguments.description: The video's id, when the first argument is a service's name.

arguments.name: title
arguments.description: A description of the video.

shortcodes.name: code
shortcodes.title: Code Listing
shortcodes.meaning: The text of a file shown as a code listing.

arguments.name: src
arguments.description: The file's path.

arguments.name: lang
arguments.description: The listing's language, when the file's name does not say.

shortcodes.name: color
shortcodes.title: Color
shortcodes.meaning: Words drawn in a colour.

arguments.name: colour
arguments.description: One of ink, muted, accent, danger, warn or positive, or a CSS colour.

shortcodes.name: class
shortcodes.title: Style Class
shortcodes.meaning: Words or blocks given a class of the document's stylesheet, which decides how they look.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: The class's name.

shortcodes.name: style
shortcodes.title: Stylesheet
shortcodes.meaning: A stylesheet kept with the document. It is never shown.

arguments.name: scope
arguments.description: slide, for a stylesheet of the one slide it is in.

shortcodes.name: kbd
shortcodes.title: Keys
shortcodes.meaning: Keys to press, each shown as a key.

arguments.name: keys
arguments.description: The keys, joined by +, such as Ctrl+Shift+P. It is the whole argument.

shortcodes.name: glyph
shortcodes.title: Glyph
shortcodes.meaning: One small symbol from the PUDL design language's set, in the line of text.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: The glyph's name.

shortcodes.name: columns
shortcodes.title: Columns
shortcodes.meaning: Content set side by side in columns. A column line inside it starts the next column.

shortcodes.name: column
shortcodes.title: Next Column
shortcodes.meaning: The divider between two columns, inside columns. It means nothing anywhere else.

shortcodes.name: no-export
shortcodes.title: Not Exported
shortcodes.meaning: Private working text that stays in the source and is left out of every export.

shortcodes.name: draft-note
shortcodes.title: Note to Self
shortcodes.meaning: A note the author wrote to themselves, shown while editing and never published.

shortcodes.name: slide
shortcodes.title: Slide Settings
shortcodes.meaning: Settings for one slide of a deck. It draws nothing itself.

arguments.name: layout
arguments.description: The slide's layout.

arguments.name: background
arguments.description: The background colour.

arguments.name: image
arguments.description: The background picture's address.

arguments.name: reveal
arguments.description: How the slide's parts are revealed.

arguments.name: transition
arguments.description: The transition to the slide.

arguments.name: class
arguments.description: The slide's style class.

shortcodes.name: notes
shortcodes.title: Speaker Notes
shortcodes.meaning: Notes for the person presenting a deck, shown to them and not on the slide.

shortcodes.name: mark
shortcodes.title: Highlight
shortcodes.meaning: Words highlighted, as with a marker.

shortcodes.name: sup
shortcodes.title: Superscript
shortcodes.meaning: Words set as superscript.

shortcodes.name: sub
shortcodes.title: Subscript
shortcodes.meaning: Words set as subscript.

shortcodes.name: page-break
shortcodes.title: Page Break
shortcodes.meaning: The end of a page. What follows starts on a new page where the document has pages.

shortcodes.name: caption
shortcodes.title: Caption
shortcodes.meaning: The caption of the figure or table just before it.

shortcodes.name: colour
shortcodes.title: Colour
shortcodes.meaning: Words drawn in a colour.

arguments.name: colour
arguments.description: One of ink, muted, accent, danger, warn or positive, or a CSS colour.

shortcodes.name: define
shortcodes.title: Define a Shortcode
shortcodes.meaning: The definition of a shortcode of the document's own. A use of that shortcode stands for the definition's body, so a destination works from the expanded text.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: The new shortcode's name.
